objective: Text normalisation removes real hyphens that are not line breaks. server/services/documents/normalize.ts ~L12 SOFT_HYPHEN_BREAK = /([A-Za-z])[-\u00ad]\s+([a-z])/g matches ordinary spaces, so normalizeBlockText('pre- and post-closing inspections; short- or long-term leases') returns 'preand post-closing …; shortor long-term leases' with the note 'rejoined hyphenated line breaks'. CLAUDE.md §9: normalisation may only remove extraction artifacts, and normalized_text is what retrieval and audits read. Fix: a hard hyphen rejoins only across a newline (/([A-Za-z])-[ \t]*\r?\n[ \t]*([a-z])/g); a soft hyphen (\u00ad) may still join across any whitespace.
expectedOutcome: Suspended hyphens survive normalisation; genuine line-break hyphenation is still rejoined.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/normalizeSuspendedHyphen.test.ts: 'pre- and post-closing' is unchanged and produces no rejoin note.
'recog-\nnition' becomes 'recognition' and a soft hyphen before a space still joins.
Existing document extraction/quality tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
